name: Dread Inquisitor (Legendary Inquisitor Archetype)
body:
Ordained with grim authority, dread inquisitors take an active role in confronting those who challenge their right to govern. By arriving unannounced, they strike fear into their enemies with the element of surprise.

Ring of Office (Ex)

At 1st level, a dread inquisitor starts with a bonded object in the form of a ring. This functions as the sacred bond ability (see above). The ring must take up an appropriate item slot in order to be used. At 7th level, the dread inquisitor gains Forge Ring as a bonus feat.

This replaces domain.

No One Expects (Ex)

A dread inquisitor gains some vigilante class features at certain levels. These features are Wisdom-based instead of Charisma-based. The dread inquisitor treats her inquisitor levels as vigilante levels for the purpose of these abilities.

At 6th level, a dread inquisitor gains startling appearance.

At 12th level, she gains frightening appearance.

At 18th level, she gains stunning appearance.

This replaces the teamwork feats gained at these levels.
